description: This file implements a client-side search functionality using the FlexSearch library and Preact for rendering search results. It defines a SearchEngine class that manages search index loading, query handling, and UI interactions.

classes.name: SearchEngine
classes.description: A class that manages search index loading, querying, and displaying search results.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads search index data asynchronously from an external script and initializes the FlexSearch Document.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts the search process, sets up event listeners for search input and navigation.

methods.name: displaySearch
methods.description: Renders the search results UI using Preact.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Closes the search UI and resets the page title.
